description: This file contains a command-line utility script for aggregating and summarizing performance CSV data related to PyTorch benchmarks, including functions for finding CSV files, computing geometric means, and generating performance reports.

methods.name: gmean
methods.description: Calculates the geometric mean of a sequence of numbers.

methods.name: find_csv_files
methods.description: Recursively searches for CSV files in a directory matching specific patterns based on the perf_compare flag.
